items.summary: Update the Message data type in backend/main.mo to support a new messageType field with variants for text, groceryList, and socialMediaLink
Extend the Message data structure in backend/main.mo to include an optional groceryItems field that stores an array of grocery item strings when messageType is groceryList
Extend the Message data structure in backend/main.mo to include an optional socialMediaUrl field that stores the URL string when messageType is socialMediaLink
Update the backend sendMessage method in main.mo to accept and validate grocery item arrays and social media URLs based on the messageType parameter
Update the useSendMessage mutation hook in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts to support sending messages with messageType, groceryItems array, and socialMediaUrl parameters

Add a grocery list composer UI in the Chat page (frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx) that allows users to add multiple grocery items to a list with an input field and add/remove buttons, then send the complete list as a single message
Add a social media link input field in the Chat page (frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx) that accepts URLs and sends them as socialMediaLink messages with basic URL validation
Update the message display logic in Chat.tsx to render grocery list messages as formatted lists with checkboxes or bullet points showing all items in the groceryItems array
Update the message display logic in Chat.tsx to render social media link messages with link preview cards showing the URL as a clickable hyperlink that opens in a new tab
Add a message type selector or toggle buttons in the Chat page UI that allows users to switch between sending regular text messages, grocery lists, and social media links
